payload.goal: Avoid a known trap on NVIDIA Blackwell GeForce/workstation (RTX PRO 5000 / SM120): 6. Multi-warp CTAs that distribute the K dim require cross-warp SMEM reduce → loses occupancy gains

problem.statement: CuTeDSL GDN Decode on sm_120 — Pitfalls -- 6. Multi-warp CTAs that distribute the K dim require cross-warp SMEM reduce → loses occupancy gains

payload.attempted: 1 warp/CTA seems "wasteful" — go to 4 warps and distribute K (1 K-row per thread). State per thread drops 4× (32 → 8 fp32). Occupancy 38% → 96%.
payload.lesson: For BV-bound recurrence kernels, prefer **V-disjoint** multi-warp (V6 design): each warp owns its own V cols, all reductions stay warp-internal. Same per-thread state size, but no SMEM cross-warp comm.
